# Third-party scripts served from this site

Kept here instead of loaded from a CDN, so no other service sees visitors' requests and the pages
work offline once installed.

## qrcode.min.js

[qrcode-generator](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator) 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, the
minified build as published on cdnjs
(`https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcode-generator/1.4.4/qrcode.min.js`, SHA-384
`mZT2gIty7ZDdOGkxfP6joZcYdMW1Jvj9dRlfpTmaJAKKXTqzygtB22k7FLe+KZC1`). It draws the QR codes of the
event pages' links ([events.js](../events.js)). MIT licence:
